rungs.title: Junior Tester
rungs.summary: Learning to find, reproduce and report defects.
rungs.knowledge: Knows test case design basics, the product and the bug tracker.
rungs.delivery: Runs written test cases and reports defects others can reproduce.
rungs.leadership: Communicates clearly with developers and keeps reports factual.

rungs.title: Tester
rungs.summary: Plans and runs testing for a feature, including automation.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in test design, exploratory testing, API testing and automation basics.
rungs.delivery: Owns the test plan for a feature and signs it off with evidence.
rungs.leadership: Works with developers early rather than at the end; explains risk plainly.

rungs.title: Senior Tester
rungs.summary: Owns quality for a product and builds its automation.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in automation, performance, security testing and what the product must never do.
rungs.delivery: Owns quality for a product; builds and maintains its automated suite.
rungs.leadership: Mentors testers and influences the definition of done across teams.

rungs.title: QA Lead
rungs.summary: Leads the test strategy and the team.
rungs.knowledge: Sets the test strategy, tooling and metrics for the company.
rungs.delivery: Owns release quality across products and the test environments.
rungs.leadership: Leads testers and is trusted to say a release is not ready.

rungs.title: Head of Quality
rungs.knowledge: Connects quality to customer trust, compliance and AI risk.
rungs.delivery: Owns the quality strategy, tooling budget and release standards.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and reports quality and risk to executives.
